[SWS_DM_00378] ControlDTCSetting influence (reset)
⌈
If ControlDTC-
Setting is set to disabled according to [SWS_DM_00910] for an event and the de-
bounce algorithm referenced by that event has the DiagnosticDebounceAlgo-
rithmProps.debounceBehavior set to reset, the DM shall reset the according
debounce counter or timer and freeze it for the time the ControlDTCSetting is set to
disabled.
⌋

⌈

ternal timer or counter based debouncing is used for an event, the DM shall reset the
